title_candidates: Claude puts chat and Cowork in one conversation
summary: Anthropic is merging Claude chat and Cowork for Pro and Max users in stages. Try a small task with fictional notes, and check which interface your account has.

primary_source.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Anthropic is merging chat and Cowork into one conversation, so a user can ask a quick question or hand over a larger task without switching modes.
The new experience rolls out gradually to Pro and Max on web, desktop, and mobile; Free and Team follow later.
Claude Docs and Claude Slides are new beta features on paid plans, while Claude Design also works in conversations.
Existing tasks, projects, connectors, skills, and artifacts carry over; Claude asks before taking actions by default.

supporting_sources.title: Claude Cowork and chat are one Claude
key_facts: Pro and Max accounts may still see separate Chat and Cowork options during the rollout; there is no manual switch to enable the new interface.
The new interface offers Manual permission mode by default and cloud tasks can continue when a laptop is closed, while local-file tasks require the desktop app to stay open.

supporting_sources.title: Get started with Claude Cowork
key_facts: Users with the older interface can still select Cowork and describe a task; progress and proposed approach are visible.

prerequisites: A Claude Pro or Max account with Cowork available; the unified interface may not have reached your account
A browser and three fictional notes; no file or app permissions are needed

steps.instruction: Open [claude.ai](https://claude.ai) and sign in. If the message box still offers **Chat** and **Cowork**, select **Cowork**. If those options are gone, start a new conversation; that means the unified interface has reached your account.
Check the permission setting in the message box. Choose **Manual** (or **Ask before acting** in the older Cowork interface) so you can review any action request.

Paste these fictional notes: 'Meeting moved to Tuesday. Ada will draft an agenda. Budget is undecided.' Ask: 'Make a one-page recap with decisions, open questions, and next actions. Use only these notes.' Submit the task; do not connect a folder or app.

Inspect Claude's approach and result. Check that it leaves the budget open and assigns the agenda to Ada. If it invents a budget or owner, ask it to remove that claim and compare the revision with the notes.
If your account offers Claude Docs, open the recap there and try one direct text edit. If Docs is absent, keep the plain recap; the beta and unified interface are rolling out separately.
